name: Enterprise 251-user synthetic environment
summary: 10 organizations, 20 finance-owned cost centers, 251 licensed users, and 16 budgets

assumptions: Usage events are atomic and never partially charged.
Seat charges and included credits use calendar-day proration.
Cost-center assignment through enterprise teams is not modeled in this fixture.
Each user has one deterministic licensing organization; random monthly selection across granting organizations is not modeled.
Cost-center included-usage controls are configured explicitly and are not created automatically.
No separate additional-usage cap is modeled beyond paid-usage policy and budgets.
